project_name: Maryland Piedmont Reliability Project / Otter Creek-Doubs 500 kV (RTEP Window 3 b3800.7)
instrument: PJM Board approval of the 2022 RTEP Window 3 b3800 portfolio ($5,143M), 2023-12-11; PJM required in-service 2027-06-01; MD PSC CPCN Case 9773 still pending 2026-07
mapping_note: New Otter Creek 500 kV station (PPL, cut into TMI-Peach Bottom) + 38-mi 500 kV to Doubs (APS seam) across northern MD — a new supply path into SWMAAC roughly parallel to the AP-South corridor (model link 4,453 MW). Spans three model zones (Central_PA origin, SWMAAC crossing, West_APS terminus) with no single-link mapping and PJM publishes component lists, not interface-TTC deltas — recorded 0.0 (rule 5); expect the uplift to arrive via refreshed measured transfer-limit postings post-COD.
notes: PJM required IS 2027-06-01 is unachievable: CPCN application still incomplete 2026-04; PSEG schedule targets final order 2027-07 + 15-18 mo construction => realistic COD 2028-2029 (in_service_year 2029).

project_name: Valley Link 765 kV - Valley North (2024 RTEP Window 1 b4000)
instrument: PJM Board approval of the 2024 RTEP Window 1 b4000 portfolio ($5,920M), 2025-02-26; PJM required in-service 2029-06-01; no state CPCN filed as of 2026-06
mapping_note: ~260-mi 765 kV John Amos (WV, AEP) -> Welton Spring (Hardy Co WV) -> Rocky Point 765/500 (Frederick Co MD, cut into Doubs-Goose Creek / Doubs-Aspen) — a new AEP->West_APS 765 kV trunk feeding the Doubs hub where the SWMAAC and Dominion seams meet (model links AEP->West_APS 5,029 / West_APS->SWMAAC 4,453 / West_APS->Dominion 3,000). No published interface-TTC delta — recorded 0.0 (rule 5).
source_doc: Valley Link project pages; PJM Feb 2025 board whitepaper
notes: Realistic in-service 2029-2031 (VA SCC filing planned 2027); Valley South (Joshua Falls->Yeat) + Vontay 765/500 station are intra-zonal within PJM_Dominion and carried in this project's notes rather than separate rows.
